angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 786,350 km at 53.84 pc = 0.2 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 18.5722 +/- 0.0239 mas (same row, RUWE 0.96): 53.84 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.1303 +/- 0.0069 solar radii from Lienhard et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1774.01 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.545f1934L/abstract): 786,350 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.991 +/- 0.027 solar masses from Lienhard et al. 2026, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1774.01 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.545f1934L/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5746 +/- 59 K from Lienhard et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1774.01 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.545f1934L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Lienhard et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1774.01 in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.545f1934L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-1774.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.328, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 85426: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1774 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.02 dex, from Lienhard et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.545f1934L/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1774 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.10143, from Giacalone et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161...24G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1774 (pscomppars): age 7.4 Gyr, from Lienhard et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.545f1934L/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1774 (pscomppars): rotation period 25 d, from Lienhard et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.545f1934L/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-1774 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Lienhard et al. 2026 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026MNRAS.545f1934L/abstract)
spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (1.13 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.874. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
